summary: User received a Discord message from an account with a team role offering a free whitelist mint and connected MetaMask to mint-preaccess.io then signed a transaction that transferred a Bored Ape NFT and 1.6 ETH to the attacker wallet.
user_mistake: Connected wallet to a mint site from unsolicited Discord message and signed transaction without verifying contract permissions
prevention: Do not connect wallet to mint links received via direct message / Inspect transaction details and contract permissions on wallet screen before signing
